Hi Marcus,

Thank you for reaching out! I'm very interested in this React Dashboard project for your DevOps monitoring tool. Your requirements align well with my experience in building real-time data visualization dashboards.

I have solid experience with:
- D3.js and modern charting libraries (Chart.js, Recharts)
- REST API integration and real-time data handling
- Role-based access control and authentication systems
- Responsive design across all devices
- Dark mode implementation

Your timeline of 4 weeks and budget of $5-6K works well for me. I'd be happy to hop on a call to discuss the project details, technical architecture, and any specific requirements you have.

Please let me know your availability for a call this week.

Best regards,
Jordan
